harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 to log every sudo command with timestamp and invoking user to /var/log/sudo-commands.log while disabling sudo syslog entries. Configuration and records persisted across a verified node restart. RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed syntax-valid /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-command-logging using sudo’s native logfile support and `!syslog`.
Created the dedicated logfile as root:root mode 0600; sudoers policy is mode 0440.
Verified unique pre- and post-restart sudo commands were timestamped with user `antrieb`.
Verified both probes were absent from /var/log/messages, /var/log/secure, and the systemd journal.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed a changed boot ID, recovered system health, active rsyslog, valid sudoers configuration, and persisted log data.

evidence.requirement: Record every sudo command with user and timestamp in /var/log/sudo-commands.log
evidence.summary: Shows the valid native sudo logfile policy, secure file permissions, and timestamped COMMAND entries identifying invoking user antrieb and target user root before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep sudo command entries out of general system logs
evidence.summary: Unique sudo probes were present in the dedicated logfile while matching zero entries in messages, secure, and the journal.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed legacy operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both baseline and final checks show RHEL Server 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 16724682-15d4-4e48-bfb9-a2913f22f416; acknowledged native delayed reboot; observed shutdown; recovered with changed boot ID 820f2a46-8f6b-4b22-af35-695c248e85ea; system running with rsyslog active/enabled, valid persisted policy, retained pre-restart record, and successful post-restart logging isolation.

attempts.summary: Configured node1 to log every sudo command with timestamp and invoking user to /var/log/sudo-commands.log while disabling sudo syslog entries. Configuration and records persisted across a verified node restart. RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160 remain unchanged.
